Sundays

At Faith Life.

Pastor Ian became a member of Faith Life in 2024 and first served as a bivocational pastor. Pastor Wendell mentored him through that season, and in 2025 he became our lead pastor.

Today his main work is shepherding the people of Faith Life and leading the preaching of the Word. He preaches most Sundays, sharing the pulpit with Pastor Wendell and Pastor Jaden so our church hears the Word through different voices.

Listen to Sunday messages

Outside Sunday.

Pastor Ian is married to Valerie. They share a love for people, and for making everyone feel welcome in the body of Christ.

They are proud foodies, always up for Korean, Vietnamese, or anything new, and they love travelling to Japan. Valerie is a teacher and runs Doxa Matcha, a matcha pop-up.
